current_difficulty_reason: Weak compactness alone does not identify the nonlinear interaction force when mass concentrates at atoms and the Lipschitz potential has a nondifferentiable diagonal. The authors symmetrize that interaction, pass both dissipative terms through the viscosity limit and use equality in the limiting energy inequality to recover the exact velocity field with zero diagonal convention. This new nonlinear measure-level identification closes the aggregation equation, beyond the standard Wasserstein compactness or gradient-flow foundations.
